title: Create src/tui/components/StatusDashboard.tsx — full dashboard layout
description: Create the full status dashboard Ink component. Composes all status sections: header, overall progress bar, focus task, category breakdown, recent activity, and session stats footer.
acceptanceCriteria: StatusDashboard renders without errors given valid props
Header shows project name and current timestamp
Overall progress bar is rendered using ProgressBar component
Current focus task panel is shown
Loop session stats footer is present

steps.details: Create the file. Import React, Box, Text from ink. Import ProgressBar. Define props: { stats: ProgressStats; activity: ActivityEntry[]; history: HistoryStats; currentTask: Task | null }
Render: <Box><Text bold color='cyan'>🚀 Rocket Status</Text><Text dimColor> · {path.basename(process.cwd())}  {new Date().toLocaleString()}</Text></Box>

steps.description: Render overall progress and category breakdown
steps.details: Render ProgressBar with overall stats. Render per-category rows: {Object.entries(stats.byCategory).map(([cat, s]) => <Text>{cat.padEnd(14)} <ProgressBar percent={s.percent} complete={s.complete} total={s.total} width={20} /></Text>)}

steps.description: Render focus task, activity, and footer
steps.details: Show currentTask info. Show last 5 activity entries from logReader. Show loop session count and total runtime from historyReader.
